title: Isivivinyo Sokomela
intro: Umphakathi, olangazelela ubuholi obuzovikela udaba lwawo, wacela ukuba kubekwe umphathi phezu kwawo. Lapho isicelo sawo siphendulwa, okhethiwe wahlangatshezwa ukungabaza, ngoba lo muntu wayengenaso isimo sezwe ayesilindele. Ngaphambi kokubhekana kokugcina, lo mholi omusha wayezohlola ukuzithiba kwebutho ngokuvivinywa okulula, kodwa okujulile, kokuzibamba.
clues: Ngamiswa njengomkhuzi wempi ngemuva kokuba abantu bakithi befune umholi ozolwela injongo kaNkulunkulu.
Abantu bami abaningi baqale bangabaza ukuqashwa kwami, bethi angicebile futhi anginalo uhlu lozalo oluhle.
Ngakhethwa ngoba u-Allah wayenginike ulwazi oluningi kanye nomzimba onamandla.
Isibonakaliso esicacile sokuqokwa kwami ​​kwaphezulu kwakuwukubuya koMphongolo weSivumelwano, uthwelwe yizingelosi, okwaletha ukuthula ezinhliziyweni zamakholwa.
Njengoba ngangihamba namasosha ami, ngamemezela ukuthi sizovivinywa ngasemfuleni.
Ngayala ibutho lami ukuthi noma ubani ophuza kakhulu emfuleni akayena owami, kanti labo abathatha isipuni esisodwa kuphela esandleni sabo bazosala.

outcome.label: Waba Yini Umphumela Womkhankaso Wami?
options: Ukuhlukanisa uLwandle Olubomvu ukuze ubalekele umashiqela
Ukusungula ubukhosi obuhlala isikhathi eside egameni lami

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
